blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many robotic construction applications, such as progress tracking, require registering a sensor trajectory to a prior 2D floor plan. Visual capture is attractive for its low cost and availability, but aligning a visual simultaneous localization and mapping (VSLAM) map to a floor plan is difficult; VSLAM recovers geometry only up to an unknown similarity transform, the sparse point cloud is cross-modal to the symbolic floor plan, sites are only partially built during capture, and construction sites are visually repetitive, degrading map quality while removing distinctive features. Existing methods address at most two of these challenges. We thus introduce Reading the Room(RR), a global-local approach to register scale-ambiguous, sparse, semantic VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans. Our key idea is to define a single robust, differentiable, class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function that governs all stages of the pipeline. We develop two global initialization schemes, leveraging a single inaccurate user-provided correspondence if provided, or estimating the initialization globally using a cross-modal matching network. Both schemes are designed to find initial candidates with respect to the energy function, which is then directly optimized for local refinement. We evaluate RR on 33 sequences across three active construction sites against classical and learning-based baselines, achieving a 4.5x improvement in mean absolute trajectory error over the strongest baseline in the general unconstrained setting, which increases to 7.6x when an anchor is provided.
blocks.zh: 许多机器人构造应用,如进度跟踪,都需要将传感器轨迹登记到之前的2D平面计划. 视觉捕捉因其成本和可用性都比较低而吸引人,但很难将视觉同步本地化和绘图(VSLAM)地图与平面图相配合;VSLAM只恢复到未知的相近变相,稀有的点云与象征平面图是交叉模式,在捕捉时场地仅部分被建造,建筑站点是视觉重复的,在去除显著特征的同时降低地图质量. 现有方法最多解决了其中两项挑战。 因此,我们介绍阅读室(RR),这是一个全球-地方方法,用于登记比例模糊、稀少、语义模糊的VSLAM地图,以便部分地层图。 我们的关键思想是界定一个单一的强健,不同,阶级平衡的语义-几何能函数,它支配着管道的各个阶段. 我们制定两个全球初始化计划,利用用户提供的单一不准确的通信,或利用跨模式匹配网络估计全球初始化。 这两项计划都旨在寻找能源功能方面的初始候选者,然后直接优化能源功能,以便在当地加以完善。 我们对照古典和以学习为基础的基线,对三个活动建筑地点的33个序列进行RRR评价,使平均绝对轨迹误差比一般无限制情况下最强基线有所改善,在提供锚时增加到7.6x。

blocks.en: I INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Autonomous robots and perception technologies have the potential to transform modern construction.
Tracking construction progress against design intent is one of the most direct levers to reduce project delays and cost overruns [ 1 ] . However, doing so requires registering a sensor trajectory captured by a robot or site operator to a prior 2D floor plan.
To this end, camera-based capture is an especially attractive sensing solution given its vast availability, low cost, weight, and energy consumption, as well as providing visual fidelity and human interpretability.
While several works investigate registering dense LiDAR-based reconstruction to floor plans [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] , the visual counterpart remains less explored.
blocks.zh:
自主机器人和感知技术具有改造现代建筑的潜力.
对照设计意图跟踪施工进度是减少项目拖延和费用超支的最直接杠杆之一[1]。 然而,这样做需要将机器人或场地操作员捕获的传感器轨迹登记在先前的2D地板计划中。
为此,基于相机的捕获是一种特别有吸引力的感知解决方案,因为它的可用性大,成本低,重量大,能耗大,还提供了视觉忠贞性和人的解释性.
虽然有几部作品在调查中将密集的LiDAR重建记录到楼层规划[2,3,4],但视觉对应方的探索仍然较少.

blocks.en:
In this work, we study the task of aligning a sparse, scale-ambiguous 3D map, as recovered by a monocular VSLAM system [ 5 , 6 ] , to the floor plan of a site under active construction.
Multiple properties compound to make this setting unusually difficult, as shown in Fig. 1 .
First, monocular VSLAM recovers geometry only up to an unknown similarity transform, since scale is not observable without auxiliary sensing.
Second, the two representations are highly cross-modal, as VSLAM outputs a sparse, noisy 3D point cloud while the floor plan is a symbolic drawing of design intent.
Third, construction sites are only partially built during capture, so large parts of the plan may not yet physically exist, making it an unreliable prior.
Lastly, such sites are often visually repetitive, consisting mostly of walls, columns, and voids, which both degrades VSLAM quality and removes the distinctive features registration typically relies on.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们研究将一个由单光谱的VSLAM系统[5,6]回收的稀疏,规模模糊的3D地图与正在积极建造的场地的地面计划相配合的任务.
如图1所示,使这种设置异常困难的多重属性复合。
第一,单体VSLAM只恢复几何学,直到未知的相似性变换,因为没有辅助感知,尺度是不可见的.
第二,两种表示方式高度交叉,因为VSLAM输出一个稀疏,吵闹的3D点云,而地板图则是象征性的设计意图图案.
第三,建筑工地在俘获时只是部分建造,因此计划的大部分可能还没有实际存在,使得它之前是不可靠的.
最后,这些场地往往具有视觉重复性,主要由墙壁、柱子和空隙组成,既降低了VSLAM的质量,又取消了通常依赖的特征登记。

blocks.en:
Existing approaches address at most one or two of these challenges.
Cross-view indoor localization methods [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] generally assume known metric scale and a fully built environment.
Methods embedding a floor plan directly into the SLAM pipeline [ 15 , 16 ] similarly assume a known, already-built environment and a metric-range sensor such as LiDAR.
Map-alignment methods such as region decomposition [ 2 ] and graph matching [ 4 ] require dense metric reconstructions a sparse VSLAM map cannot easily supply.
Recent sparse VSLAM methods instead by-pass dense reconstruction by detecting manually placed visual markers with positions marked a-priori in the floor plan [ 17 ] .
Learning-based cross-modal matchers [ 18 , 19 ] can generalize across visually dissimilar modalities [ 20 , 21 ] , but have never been evaluated on this domain.
Thus, no existing method jointly handles unknown scale, sparse representations, the cross-modality gap, and partial construction.
blocks.zh:
现有办法最多可处理其中一两个挑战。
交叉视野室内局部化方法[7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14]一般采用已知的公尺尺度和完全建成的环境.
将地板计划直接嵌入SLAM管道的方法[15,16] 类似地假设一个已知的、已经建成的环境和LiDAR等度程传感器。
区域分解[2]和图表匹配[4]等地图调整方法需要密集的度量重建,一个稀少的VSLAM地图不易提供.
最近很少使用VSLAM方法,而是通过检测手动放置的视觉标记进行密集的重建,这些标记的位置在地板图中标为优先位置[17].
基于学习的跨模式匹配者[18,19]可以泛泛跨视差模式[20,21],但从未对此领域进行过评价.
因此,没有任何现行方法共同处理未知的尺度、稀疏的表示、跨模式差距和部分构造。

blocks.en:
To close this gap, we introduce Reading the Room (RR), a global-local registration approach built around a single energy function.
We propose a robust, differentiable, class-balanced semantic-geometric objective for cross-modal registration in partially built construction sites.
We then develop a two stage approach to globally initialize and locally refine this (or any other) energy function in feature-degraded and structurally ambiguous environments.
We thoroughly evaluate RR across 3 datasets of active construction sites spanning 33 total sequences.
For practical relevance, we consider two cases, where an initial guess by a site operator is provided as well as the unconstrained global regsitration task, both of which are naturally handled by RR.
We compare RR against several classical and learning-based methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance in both tasks.
In summary, our main contributions are:
blocks.zh:
为了缩小这一差距,我们采用了 " 阅读会议室 " (RR),这是一种围绕单一能源功能的全球-地方登记办法。
我们提出在部分建筑工地进行跨模式登记的一个有力、不同、分类平衡的语义几何目标。
然后,我们制定两阶段办法,在全球初始化,并在特征降低和结构模糊的环境中,在当地完善这种(或任何其他)能源功能。
我们彻底评估了3组在建工程现场的经常资源,涉及33个总序列。
就实际相关而言,我们考虑两种情况,即提供站点操作员的初步猜测以及不受限制的全球重新管制任务,这两种任务自然由区域资源评估处理。
我们比较RR与几种古典和以学习为基础的方法,并在这两项任务中都取得了最先进的业绩.
总之,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: II RELATED WORK
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Cross-view Localization
blocks.zh: II-A 交叉视图本地化

blocks.en:
Cross-view localization aims to localize a query image directly against a floor plan, without a SLAM algorithm or multi-view constraints in the loop.
Early work scored predicted room-layout edges against projected floor-plan edges [ 7 ] .
Embedding-based methods such as LaLaLoc [ 8 ] and its successors [ 9 , 10 ] instead learn a shared panorama/floor-plan latent space.
More recently, methods render or predict depth and sometimes semantic rays [ 11 ] from candidate poses and compare them against observed depth [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] .
These methods rest on several assumptions we cannot make.
First, depth-ray methods require a known pixel-to-metre ratio, whereas our floor plans carry no reliable scale.
Second, we instead register a sparse map, which is easier to store, transmit, and anonymize than full single views.
Finally, all of these methods assume the built environment matches the plan closely, which may fail when large parts of a site are not yet built.
blocks.zh:
交叉视图本地化旨在将一个查询图像直接针对一个楼层计划本地化,没有SLAM算法或循环中的多视图限制.
早期工作在预测的底板边缘上打分 [7].
嵌入式方法,如LaLaLoc [8] 及其后继者[9,10],而是学习一个共享的全景/底片潜在空间。
最近,方法产生或预测来自候选人的深度和有时是语义射线[11],并将其与观测到的深度[12、13、14]进行比较。
这些方法基于我们无法作出的几种假设。
首先,深度射线方法需要已知的像素对米比,而我们的地板图则没有可靠的尺度.
第二,我们登记一张稀少的地图,它比完整的单一视图更容易存储、传输和匿名。
最后,所有这些方法都假定建造的环境与计划很吻合,当一个场地的大部分尚未建成时,计划可能会失败.

blocks.en: II-B SLAM with Floor Plan Priors
blocks.zh: II-B SLAM 带楼层计划

blocks.en:
A separate line of work integrates a floor plan directly as a prior into a tracking or SLAM pipeline, rather than registering a map to the plan later.
FP-Loc [ 15 ] tracks a 3D LiDAR from a known start pose against a floor plan by detecting ceiling/ground planes and matching wall features to floor-plan elements via an approximate nearest-neighbour field. Zimmerman et al. [ 16 ] extend this to global localization with a semantic map whose object-level cues resolve the structural symmetry via Monte Carlo localization. However, these methods assume a known, already-built environment and a metric-range sensor (LiDAR) that directly observes scale, neither of which holds in our setting.
blocks.zh:
单独的一行工程将地板计划直接作为前期计划纳入跟踪或SLAM管道,而不是在以后的计划中注册地图.
FP-Loc [15]通过探测天花板/地面飞机,通过近距离近距离的场景将墙面特征与地面平面元素相匹配,从已知的起动姿势对地平面图跟踪3D LiDAR. 齐默曼等. [16] 以一个语义图将其对象级提示通过蒙特卡洛本地化解决结构对称性,将其延伸至全球本地化. 然而,这些方法假设一种已知的、已经建成的环境和一个直接观测尺度的测量距离传感器(LiDAR)。

blocks.en: II-C Map Registration
blocks.zh: II-C 地图登记

blocks.en:
Complementarily, map registration aims to estimate a rigid or similarity transform aligning a SLAM map to a floor plan.
Most prominently, point cloud methods such as ICP [ 22 ] align dense LiDAR scans to reference geometry.
Recent works couple this with as-planned BIM/CAD models; diS-Graphs [ 23 ] jointly optimizes pose and a non-rigid plan deformation, while Lidar2BIM [ 3 ] registers a LiDAR map to a BIM model via a Hough-transform.
However, these methods assume a metric range sensor, whereas in our case scale is an unknown the algorithm must recover.
Alternatively, if scale is unknown but the modalities match, registration can be posed as a 2D image-alignment problem. Manual-correspondence methods sidestep the transform search entirely; Lu et al. [ 24 ] use a 360-degree camera and VSLAM in construction but require several site-manager-selected tie points, while Bagh et al. [ 17 ] require physical fiducial markers that are also manually annotated on the plan.
The closest unconstrained approach is region decomposition [ 2 , 25 , 26 ] , which registers a dense occupancy grid map to a floor plan by scoring candidate region overlap.
A related graph-based work [ 4 ] matches regions with a learned graph network instead.
All of these methods require a dense or volumetric reconstruction, which in a sparse, monocular VSLAM setting cannot reliably be produced.
blocks.zh:
作为补充,地图登记旨在估计一个刚性或相似性,将SLAM地图与地面计划相匹配。
最显著的是点云方法,如ICP[22]将密集的LiDAR扫描与参考几何相配合.
近期的作品将这与规划中的BIM/CAD模型结合;diS-Graphs [23] 联合优化了姿势和非刚性计划变形,而Lidar2BIM [3] 通过Hough-transform将LiDAR地图注册到BIM模型.
然而,这些方法假设一个度量范围传感器,而对我们来说,这个算法是未知的,必须恢复。
或者,如果规模不明,但模式匹配,登记可作为一个二维图像对齐问题提出。 手动对应方法完全避开变换搜索; Lu et al. [24] 在建筑中使用360度的相机和VSLAM,但需要几个现场管理选取的领带点,而Bagh et al. [17] 需要实物微分标记,在计划上也要手动注释.
最接近的不受限制的方法是区域分解[2,25,26],通过评分候选人区域重叠,将密集的占用网格图记录到一个楼层计划.
相关的基于图表的工作[4]将区域与学习的图表网络匹配。
所有这些方法都需要密集的或体积的重建,在稀疏的单一VSLAM环境中无法可靠地生产.

blocks.en: II-D Cross-modal Feature Matching
blocks.zh: II-D 跨模式特性匹配

blocks.en:
An alternative to registering full maps is to match local features between two images directly, without reducing either to an occupancy grid.
Classical descriptors such as SIFT [ 27 ] remain a common choice to match keypoints via handcrafted, scale- and illumination-invariant descriptors.
Learned sparse matchers instead match detected keypoints (typically from SuperPoint [ 28 ] ) via attention, as in SuperGlue [ 29 ] and LightGlue [ 30 ] .
Detector-free dense matchers such as LoFTR [ 18 ] , its efficient variant [ 31 ] , and RoMa [ 19 ] regress correspondences over a dense grid, which tend to outperform sparse matchers precisely in the low-texture, repetitive conditions that also characterize construction sites.
All of these matchers are trained for same-modality correspondence and are not, by default, cross-modal. MatchAnything [ 20 ] and MINIMA [ 21 ] address this gap without changing the underlying architecture by fine-tuning existing matchers on large synthetic cross-modal datasets (such as optical-to-infrared or optical-to-map imagery).
Both report that dense matchers retain their advantage over sparse and semi-dense ones even after cross-modal adaptation, suggesting cross-modal generalization is largely a property of training data rather than architecture.
However, neither framework has yet considered the domain gap of sparse, unscaled VSLAM maps against a symbolic floor plan.
blocks.zh:
登记完整地图的替代办法是将两个图像之间的局部特征直接匹配,而不降低到占用网格。
如SIFT[27]等经典描述符仍然是通过手工,规模和照明变异描述符匹配键位的常见选择.
所学的稀少的配对者则通过注意来匹配检测到的键点(通常来自SuperPoint [28]),如SuperGlue [29]和LightGlue [30].
探测器无密度匹配器,如LoFTR [18],其高效变体[31],以及RoMa [19]在密集的网格上反射对应器,在同样是建筑工地特点的低质,重复性条件下,其性能往往恰好超过稀少的匹配器.
所有这些匹配者都接受了同一种模式的通信培训,但默认不是交叉模式。 MINIMA[21]和MINIMA[21]通过在大型合成跨模式数据集(例如光学到红外或光学到映射图像)上对现有匹配器进行微调,在不改变基本结构的情况下解决这一差距。
两份报告都说,密集的匹配者即使在跨模式调整后仍然比稀少和半密集的匹配者拥有优势,这表明跨模式通用基本上是培训数据而不是结构的一部分。
然而,这两个框架都没有参照象征性的平面计划,考虑稀疏的未缩放VSLAM地图的域间隙。

blocks.en:
An overview of our method, Reading the Room (RR), is shown in Fig. 2 .
First, preprocessing (Sec. IV-A ) transforms the provided map M M into a modality more similar to the floor plan F F .
The central idea of our approach is to define a single energy function (Sec. IV-B ) that governs the coarse and fine registration steps.
To this end, a global initialization is estimated (Sec. IV-C ) considering the initial correspondence if provided, or estimating it globally using cross-modal dense correspondence matching.
Finally, a local step (Sec. IV-D ) refines the alignment of the map to the floor plan.

blocks.en:
Since the map M M lives in a higher-dimensional space and represents a different modality than the floor plan F F , we first aim to reduce this representation gap.
Since floor plans do not capture the vertical dimension, we remove this extra degree of freedom by estimating the direction of gravity using Principal Component Analysis (PCA) on the mean-centred landmark cloud.
Exploiting that most landmarks in built environments lie on the floor, ceiling, or wall surfaces, we find the eigenvector of least variance to be a robust proxy for verticality.
Similarly, while floor plans contain only structural elements such as walls, pillars, or stairs, the majority of map points typically lie on the floor and ceiling, which are not captured in F F .
To reduce this representation mismatch, floor and ceiling points are filtered out by retaining only the 15 th {}^{\text{th}} to 85 th {}^{\text{th}} percentiles of the height histogram.
The remaining points are orthographically projected onto the horizontal plane, resulting in a shared bird’s-eye-view (BEV) representation for both the map and plan.

blocks.en:
The central idea of our approach is to define a single energy function which governs all other components of Reading the Room .
This makes our architecture very flexible to adapt to other settings by defining other energy functions.
While many functions are admissible, we define the following semantic registration cost for our problem.
Since no explicit correspondences link the sparse landmark cloud to the floor plan, we score a candidate transform by how close each landmark lands to the nearest floor-plan structure of its own class.
For each class c ∈ 𝒞 c\in\mathcal{C} , this proximity is the Euclidean distance to the nearest floor-plan pixel of class c c .
For efficiency we pre-compute this once per floor plan as a distance transform DT c \mathrm{DT}_{c} over F F ’s class mask, reducing each candidate’s score to a constant-time lookup.
A candidate transform maps landmark p i p_{i} to floor-plan pixel coordinates q i q_{i} , scored via bilinear interpolation of d i = DT c ⁡ ( i ) ​ ( q i ) d_{i}=\mathrm{DT}_{c(i)}(q_{i}) at every labelled landmark.
To avoid not-yet-built structures influencing other landmarks, we only score the candidate transform with respect to the plan and not vice-versa.
Since landmarks are sparse and noisy, and construction sites often contain clutter, such as equipment or materials with no floor-plan counterpart, we truncate d i d_{i} at τ \tau such that outlier landmarks cannot dominate the cost, then aggregate the remainder with an additional Huber penalty ρ δ \rho_{\delta} .
This cost is quadratic for informative gradients near good alignments but only linear for the larger residuals that are still common, while zeroing far-out estimates, thus keeping the objective well-behaved under gradient-based refinement (Sec. IV-D ).
Finally, because construction sites are often self-similar and most classes other than wall are rare, we average the confidence-weighted residual within each class independently and only then average across classes, giving a sparse but distinctive class (such as stairs) equal weight to more common ones.

Correspondence-based global search. When no anchor is available, an unconstrained global initial transform needs to be estimated.
We approach this through cross-modal dense feature matching.
Our architecture is based on RoMa [ 19 ] , however, we find that this matching network does not generalize well to our setting, even with large pre-trained cross-modal weights from MatchAnything [ 20 ] .
We instead propose a synthetic dataset to fine-tune RoMa [ 19 ] initialized with MatchAnything [ 20 ] weights.

From only 100 labelled drawings we produce 2000 map–floor plan pairs. Each floor plan is cropped to a random per-axis fraction in [ 0.6 , 1 ] [0.6,1] to model partial trajectory coverage, then sparsified by retaining [ 3 % , 10 % ] [3\%,10\%] of foreground pixels to approximate landmark density. To simulate occluded, undetected, or not-yet-built structure, 1–10 rectangular patches ( 5 % 5\% – 25 % 25\% of the image each) are blacked out with probability 0.9.
We model noise by adding spurious clutter points and adding Gaussian positional jitter to all points.
We apply random rotation θ ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ [ − 180 ∘ , 180 ∘ ] \theta\sim\mathcal{U}[-180^{\circ},180^{\circ}] , log-uniform scale in [ 0.8 , 1.25 ] [0.8,1.25] , and translation up to 10 % 10\% of image size as the ground truth transform to recover. Thus, rather than relying on the accuracy of the network’s identified correspondences, as standard RANSAC [ 33 ] would, we instead generate several candidate transforms.

blocks.en:
Datasets. We evaluate our method on 3 datasets, spanning 33 trajectories across 3 sites, 14 floors, and 2 countries. Sequences are captured on a custom device with synchronized LiDAR and 360° imagery.
The LiDAR points are used only to estimate the ground truth trajectory, which is manually aligned to the floor plan by an expert.
As a VSLAM solution, maps obtained from the equirectangular variant of OpenVSLAM [ 5 ] are provided.

Baselines. As outlined in Sec. II , we are not aware of any methods directly addressing the problem at hand.
We therefore compare against several of the most closely related baselines.
For the correspondence-based global registration, we compare against SIFT [ 27 ] +RANSAC [ 33 ] as a classical feature-based method, and RoMa [ 19 ] with pretrained weights from MatchAnything [ 20 ] representing the state-of-the-art in learnt cross-modal feature matching.
Most closely related to ours, we further compare against the region decomposition approach of Shahbandi and Magnusson [ 2 ] , which was specifically designed for map-to-floor-plan alignment, albeit for denser maps than are typically obtainable by VSLAM.
When an initial anchor is provided, we compare against Iterative Closest Point (ICP) [ 22 ] and its semantic variant (Semantic ICP). For a fair comparison, we augment both variants to initialize with the same anchor correspondence as our method and iteratively refit scale, rotation, and translation via closed-form Umeyama/orthogonal Procrustes [ 34 ] on nearest-neighbor correspondences.
blocks.zh:
基线。 如第二节所述,我们不知道有任何直接处理当前问题的方法。
因此,我们比较了几个关系最密切的基线。
对于基于通信的全球注册,我们比较了SIFT [27] +RANSAC [33] 作为一种古典的基于特征的方法,以及RoMa [19] 使用Match Anything [20] 的预先训练的权重,代表了所学到的跨模式特征匹配中最先进的.
与我们最密切相关的是,我们进一步比较了Shahbandi和Magnusson[2]的区域分解方法,该方法是专门为地图到底图的对齐设计的,尽管比VSLAM通常获得的更密集的地图。
当提供初始锚时,我们比较了Iperative Closest Point(ICP)[22]及其语义变体(Semantic ICP). 为了进行公平的比较,我们增加了两种变体,以与我们的方法相同的锚定函数初始化,并在最近的近邻函数上通过闭式Umeyama/orthogonal Procrustes[34]进行迭代重载比例、旋转和翻译。

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 : Qualitative registration results for one representative sequence per site, increasing in difficulty from top to bottom.
VSLAM BEV maps are rotated and scaled for visualization; this does not reflect their initial condition for registration.
On Site A, all three methods recover visually similar trajectories, consistent with the small floor area, high coverage, and unique structural layout of the site.
In Site B, the RoMa+MatchAnything collapses the entire map into several rooms. This yields a low cost as the outer walls align with the room walls, highlighting the challenge of scale-ambiguous registration.
In Site C, both RoMa+MatchAnything and our approach fail due to the symmetry of the scene and align the sparse observations flipped.
If a single noisy user-provided anchor is available, our method can leverage this to recover the right symmetry and achieve a good solution in spite of orientation and scale ambiguity.
blocks.zh:
图3:每个场地一个代表性序列的定性登记结果,从上到下难度增加.
VSLAM BEV地图被旋转和缩放以可视化;这并不反映其初始注册条件.
现场 A,所有三种方法都恢复视觉相似的轨迹,与面积小,覆盖度高,场地结构布局独特一致.
在B站点中,RoMa+Match Anything将整个地图倒塌成多个房间. 由于外墙与房间墙对齐,费用低廉,突出了规模模糊的登记挑战。
在C站点中,RoMa+Match Anything和我们的方法都因场景的对称性而失败,并且将翻转的稀疏的观测对齐.
如果有单一的噪音用户提供的锚,我们的方法就能够利用它来恢复正确的对称性,并在方向和尺度模糊的情况下达成一个好的解决方案.

blocks.en:
The performance of all methods across all datasets is shown in Tab. II .
First, we observe that the maps obtained from VSLAM, in spite of loop closure and global optimization, are not perfectly drift free, adding to the challenges of the registration task.
To quantify this, we report an oracle performance by directly fitting the trajectory to the ground truth path via Umeyama/orthogonal Procrustes [ 34 ] .
This residual error of approximately 1m on average is thus a lower bound on the performance that can be achieved.
Given the difficulty of the task at hand, we leave non-rigid registration and floor-plan conditioned trajectory deformation, required to eliminate the final residual error, for future work.
blocks.zh:
所有数据集中所有方法的性能在Tab中显示. 二、导 言
第一,我们观察到,从VSLAM获得的地图尽管环路关闭和全球优化,但并非完全自由漂移,增加了登记任务的挑战。
为了量化这一点,我们通过Umeyama/正交Procrustes[34] 将轨迹直接与地面真理路径匹配,从而报告甲骨文性能。
因此,这一平均大约1米的剩余误差对可实现的性能影响较小。
鉴于手头的任务很困难,我们为今后的工作留下了消除最后遗留错误所需的非固定登记和地面规划的轨道变形。

blocks.en:
Correspondence-based Global Methods. We observe that SIFT [ 27 ] +RANSAC [ 33 ] fails on 32 of 33 runs, as the modality gap between VSLAM map and floor plan is too large for classical feature matching to bridge.
RoMa [ 19 ] +MatchAnything [ 20 ] is the strongest prior baseline and manages to find solutions for all cases.
However, performance degrades sharply with building complexity.
This is most evident in the recall dropping to 0 for Site B and Site C.
Qualitative results in Fig. 3 illustrate some of the challenges inherent in our problem setting.
While the matching performance is high on Site A, challenges such as self-similarity of the rooms in Site B lead to local minima where the entire plan collapses into smaller rooms, or the symmetry in Site C leading to a result that is 180 ∘ flipped.
This suggests that some pretrained cross-modal correspondences can be found but only yield usable results when the site is simple and visually distinct enough to resolve scale and rotation ambiguities without further adaptation, which is rarely the case in construction settings.
Shahbandi and Magnusson [ 2 ] has been designed for this case, however, their region matching approach requires a dense reconstruction for optimal performance.
In our setting, this produces a valid transform only on 10/33 runs, highlighting the challenge of having to operate on sparser landmarks.
This is particularly pronounced in Site C, where the site coverage of only 28.7% contains too little boundary structure for their assumptions to hold, leading to a 0% success rate.
In contrast, our approach achieves significant improvements, reducing mean ATE by 72% compared to the most competitive baseline.
Most notably, while outliers fail catastrophically and drive up mean ATE, our energy function for global matching and refinement yields many more close results, manifesting in a 359% improvement in median ATE and significantly higher recall.
While our method achieves the best results for Site A and is the only method to succeed in Site B, we also fail to correctly register Site C, underscoring the difficulty of the task and need for further research.
blocks.zh:
以通信为基础的全球方法。 我们观察到,SIFT [27] + RANSAC [33] 在33个运行中的32个运行失败,因为VSLAM映射和地板图之间的模式间隙太大,无法匹配古典特征到桥.
Roma [19] + Match anything [20] 是之前最强的基准,并设法找到所有案例的解决方案.
然而,随着建筑的复杂性,性能急剧下降。
这在B站点和C站点的召回率降至0就最为明显。
图3的定性结果说明了我们问题设定中固有的一些挑战。
虽然匹配性能在Site A上较高,但B站点各房间的自我相似性等挑战导致当地微型马,整个计划倒塌为较小的房间,或者C站点的对称性导致180QQ翻转的结果.
这表明,可以找到一些经过预先培训的跨模式函证,但只有在场地简单且具有视觉特征,足以解决规模和旋转模糊性而不作进一步调整的情况下,才能产生有用的结果,在建筑环境中,情况很少如此。
Shahbandi和Magnusson[2]是针对这一案例设计的,但是,它们的区域匹配方法需要密集的重建,才能取得最佳业绩。
在我们的环境下,这只在10/33跑道上产生有效的转变,突出了必须在较少的地标上运作的挑战。
这一点在C站点中尤为突出,该站点覆盖率仅为28.7%,其边界结构太小,无法维持,导致成功率达到0%。
相反,我们的方法取得了显著的改进,与最具竞争力的基准相比,平均ATE减少了72%。
最明显的是,虽然外部效应在灾难性情况下失败,导致平均ATE上升,但全球匹配和完善的能量功能却产生许多更接近的结果,表现为中位ATE增长了359%,回升明显提高。
虽然我们的方法为站点A取得了最佳结果,也是B站成功的唯一方法,但我们也未能正确登记站点C,突出了任务的困难和进一步研究的需要.

blocks.en:
Anchored Methods. Tab. II shows that providing a single anchoring correspondence guess can significantly improve registration performance.
Especially in Site C, where all correspondence-based global methods failed, an initial guess is crucial in anchoring the partial observations, allowing RR to achieve a median ATE of only 4.37m and 57% recall@5m.
However, it becomes evident that an initial guess alone is not sufficient to solve the problem given scale and rotation ambiguity, as the ATE for ICP remains high.
Similarly, while semantics alone improve the ICP performance, there remains a notable performance gap.
In contrast, our robust and class-balanced global energy function used for candidate scoring and refinement achieves practically relevant results across most sites.
This is also reflected in the qualitative results in Fig. 3 , where the provided anchor is able to resolve the symmetry issue in Site C, although the scale is not quite perfect yet.
blocks.zh:
焦虑的方法。 标签。 二显示,提供单一主播函证猜想可以显著提高注册性能.
特别是在Site C,所有基于通信的全球方法都失败了,初始猜测对于锁定部分观测至关重要,允许RR实现中位ATE只有4.37m和57%的召回@5m.
然而,由于比较方案ATE仍然很高,显然仅靠初步猜测不足以解决规模和轮换模糊的问题。
同样,虽然单是语义学可以改善比较方案的业绩,但仍然存在明显的业绩差距。
相比之下,我们用于候选人评分和完善的强健和阶级平衡的全球能源功能在大多数地点都取得了实际相关的成果。
这一点也反映在图3的质量结果中,在图3中,提供的主播能够解决C站点的对称性问题,尽管比例表尚不十分完美.

The results are aggregated in Tab. III .

blocks.en:
Energy Function. We isolate the contribution of our robust class-balanced semantic-geometric cost in the global registration setting by ablating each component of ( 2 ).
We use only our robust geometric distance term (Geometric), adding the semantic weights (Semantic), as well as the additional class-imbalance aware aggregation (Ours).
While the semantic information yields the largest improvement, each component further raises performance across all sites.
This demonstrates the importance of not only having robust costs for partially built scenes but also accounting for the self-similarity and scarcity of semantic landmarks in construction.
blocks.zh:
能源函数. 我们孤立了我们在全球登记设置中强有力的分类平衡语义-几何成本的贡献,方法是分解(2)的每个组成部分。
我们只使用强势的几何距离术语(Geometric),添加语义权重(Semantic),以及额外的类平衡意识聚合(Ours).
虽然语义信息带来最大的改进,但每个组成部分都进一步提高了所有网站的性能。
这表明,不仅需要为部分建成的场景花费大量费用,而且还需要考虑到建筑中语义地标的自我相似性和稀缺性。

blocks.en:
Importance of the Global Initialization Scoring. To test whether refinement alone can recover a correct alignment, we anchor the map at the same user-selected position and utilize the same energy function, but replace our global initialization strategy (Sec. IV-C ) with a deterministic grid search, where instead of sampling and pre-scoring candidates every grid point is refined and the best result is kept.
We use the same distribution as for our search for the grid and select 32 orientations × \times 32 scales for 1024 total initializations.
The results in Tab. III demonstrate the highly complex energy landscape of this registration problem, where even for a dense uniform grid many solutions end up in suboptimal local minima.
While our approach requires more samples, pre-scoring the candidates with our energy function before refinement makes this an efficient approach.
blocks.zh:
全球初始化分数的重要性。 为了检验光是改进是否能够恢复正确的配对,我们把地图固定在同一用户选择的位置,并使用同样的能量功能,但用确定性的电网搜索取代我们的全球初始化战略(Sec. IV-C),在这种战略中,每个电网点的采样和预评候选人都得到改进并保持最佳结果。
我们使用与搜索网格相同的分布,并选择32个方向×\time 32天秤,共初始化1024天.
塔布结果. III显示了这种登记问题的高度复杂的能源景观,即使在密集的统一网格中,许多解决方案最终会出现在当地微小的不理想中。
虽然我们的方法需要更多的样本,但在完善之前对具有我们能量功能的候选人进行预先评分,使这种方法成为一个有效的方法。

blocks.en:
Importance of Local Refinement. While the previous experiments showed the importance of the global stage, we here analyse the importance of the local refinement.
To this end, we run both global stages, i.e., with and without an anchor provided, both with and without the final refinement stage.
While we observe that the global stage, i.e., finding the right local minimum attraction basin, dominates the performance, our unified energy function proves to be effective also in driving the estimate toward the exact local minimum and consistently improves the median ATE by ∼ \sim 24% on average.
blocks.zh:
地方完善的重要性。 虽然前几次实验显示了全球舞台的重要性,但我们在此分析了当地改进的重要性。
为此,我们同时进行两个全球阶段的工作,即不论有无提供锚,无论是否有最后的改进阶段。
虽然我们观察到全球舞台,即找到合适的局部最小吸引力盆地, 占据了业绩的主导地位, 但是我们的统一能源功能也证明是有效的, 将估计值推向精确的局部最小值,

blocks.en:
Robustness to Anchor Inaccuracy. We compare our anchored pipeline under the noisy, user-marked anchor used throughout all experiments in this paper against providing the ground-truth anchor.
While the more accurate anchor tends to yield better performance, our approach overall drops only 4.4% in median ATE, demonstrating the robustness of our method to inaccurate anchor placement.
This is achieved through our two stage global scoring + local refinement approach, where our robust energy function subsumes additional inaccuracies.
Robustness to anchor placement by real construction site operators further suggests the practical relevance of our approach.
blocks.zh:
坚固至安住不净. 我们比较了本文所有试验中使用的、有用户标记的噪音锚下的锚与提供地面实况锚的管道。
虽然更精确的锚点往往能产生更好的性能,但整体上,我们的方法在中位值ATE中只下降了4.4%,这表明我们的方法对不准确的锚点定位的稳健性.
这是通过我们两个阶段的全球评分+地方完善办法实现的,我们强有力的能源功能包含了更多的不准确之处。
实实在在的施工现场运营商稳健地锚定位置,进一步表明我们的方针具有实际意义.

blocks.en:
Candidate Scoring vs. Correspondence Matching. As a final study, we compare our approach to score a range of candidate transforms provided by the global matching network (Sec. IV-C ) using our energy function against optimizing the number of matching correspondences using RANSAC [ 33 ] .
While RANSAC is effective at finding the largest inlier set, because the landmarks present in partial construction settings are so self-similar and the scenes are structurally similar or symmetric, the largest inlier set does not yield the optimal transform in this case.
In comparison, our method evaluates a number of the most confident correspondences predicted by the network and scores them globally using our energy function, which yields a significantly improved estimate that can be passed on to local refinement.
blocks.zh:
候选人Scoring vs. 通信匹配。 作为最后一项研究,我们将我们利用我们的能量功能对全球匹配网络(Sec. IV-C)提供的一系列候选变换的评分方法与使用RANSAC[33]优化匹配函数进行比较。
虽然RANSAC在寻找最大的加压器集方面是有效的,因为部分构造设置中存在的地标具有如此的自我相似性,场景结构相似或对称,但最大的加压器集在此情况下并没有产生最佳的变换.
相比之下,我们的方法评价了网络预测的一些最自信的函证,并用我们的能量功能在全球进行评分,由此得出了大为改进的估计数,可以传递给当地的完善.

blocks.en:
The runtime of each stage of Reading the Room is shown in Tab. IV .
All experiments are run on an Intel Core i9-10900K CPU, with the matching network running on an NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU.
Overall, we note that our efficient implementation achieves registration results within only a few seconds.
We observe significantly faster runtimes for the correspondence-based global initialization.
While the network inference accounts for the largest share of ∼ \sim 75%, far fewer candidates are scored compared to the anchored approach, making it ∼ 6 × \sim 6\times faster overall.
However, this gap is not uniform across sites, as the correspondence-based runtime stays comparatively stable regardless of scene content while the anchored search scales with the number of observed landmarks, growing on the larger more densely covered Site B.
Inversely, the local refinement is faster for the anchored approach, as fewer iterations are needed.
Nonetheless, the runtime cost is dominated by the global initialization stage.
This highlights a practical trade-off between the two strategies, where the anchored pipeline’s accuracy (Tab. II ) comes at an increased and less predictable runtime cost.
In summary, we believe that with only few seconds of CPU runtime our approach is practical for robot localization or operation by a site manager.
blocks.zh:
阅读室的每个阶段的运行时间都用Tab显示. 四、建 议
所有实验都运行在Intel Core i9-10900K CPU上,匹配网络运行在NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPU上.
总体而言,我们注意到,我们高效率地执行《公约》,在短短几秒钟内就取得了登记结果。
我们观测到基于通信的全球初始化运行时间明显加快。
虽然网络推论占75%的最大份额,但与定点方法相比,考生得分要少得多,这使总的考生得分快得多。
然而,各站点之间的这一差距并不一致,因为不论场景内容如何,基于通信的运行时间都保持相对稳定,而锚定的搜索尺度则与观测到的地标数目相同,在覆盖范围更广的B站点上不断增长。
反之,当地对固定方法的改进速度更快,因为需要的迭代减少。
然而,运行时间成本主要是全球初始化阶段。
这突出说明了两种战略之间的实际权衡,即固定管道的准确性(Tab. II)增加运行时间成本,而且不可预测。
简而言之,我们相信,只要几秒钟的CPU运行时间,我们的方法就对机器人本地化或由站点管理者操作是实用的.

blocks.en: VI CONCLUSION
blocks.zh: 六、结 论

blocks.en:
We presented Reading the Room, a global-local method for registering scale-ambiguous, sparse VSLAM maps to partially built floor plans. At its core is a novel robust, class-balanced semantic-geometric energy function that scores candidate transforms without requiring correspondences, remains robust to unbuilt structure and outlier landmarks, and weights rare but distinctive classes equally with common ones.
This same function drives global initialization, using either anchored search or cross-modal matching, as well as local refinement.
Across 33 sequences over three active construction sites, our solution outperforms classical and learning-based baselines, achieving a 4.5 × \times or greater improvement in median ATE over the strongest prior baseline and a median ATE below 2m when an anchor is provided. Ablations confirm that each component contributes to this performance, and that RR is robust to anchor inaccuracy.
Nonetheless, registration remains unreliable on our hardest site, where low coverage and symmetry drive all methods into incorrect minima.
As our oracle analysis reveals a residual error of approximately 1 m as a result of VSLAM drift, future work should explore non-rigid, floor-plan-conditioned trajectory deformation.
Similarly, further mechanisms to resolve symmetric ambiguities without manual anchoring and correspondence matching in self-similar environments are promising avenues for future research.
